classification.explanatory: PASS is convergence of the selected CLASS interpolation operator on the SAME original window; it is NOT independent time-integration convergence, full line-of-sight lensing, finite-eta physical signal, or observational evidence.

motivation: Result-informed follow-up to LW02: its 5–8 native redshift-node trapezoidal lensing integral has sign instability under alternative postrun quadratures.

replay.reason: CLASS off-native source-time interpolation versus sparse native Fourier-time array; v078 showed those operators need not coincide.

projection.new_redshift_domain: preserve each LW02 ell's original first and last k-valid native z points; ell500 remains excluded by original <4 nodes rule
projection.chi_sampling_mode: uniform comoving distance for each ell-specific original LW02 chi domain
projection.k_interpolation: linear in log physical native k; no out-of-window extrapolation
projection.background: original frozen CLASS comoving distance; compare to LW02 chi for exact eight native z points
projection.observable: Born+Limber formal signed tangent of window-only kappa-kappa angular power

scientific_caveats: This is a source-time interpolation replay; it does not yield independent new perturbation time samples.
Only one lambda pair is rerun because prior LW01 already proved four-lambda native affinity; compare the same lambda pair at original native times before interpreting.
Do not call a sign robust from this single operator unless an independent time-sampling or solver-resolution check passes.
A 33-to-65 quadrature pass is a discretization check of a single interpolation operator, not an end-to-end Boltzmann accuracy certificate.
No new k,z window, no observation-based tuning, no parameter scan, no H4 numeric reopening.
